name: kodo_guide
notes: The full Kodo pipeline. `label` is deliberately NOT the agent's display_name: the feed calls this agent 'Kōdo' (its frontmatter display_name), while the picker has always called the choice 'Guide' — naming the option after the product would read as 'pick Kodo' in a list of Kodo's own agents. Every built-in agent carries the `kodo_` prefix so a user-installed agent can never collide with one; the prefix is reserved and refused on user files.
label: Guide
